creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From the Lectern page muster-ui-redesign, section "Messages". The banner takes the conversation's parts: the author's avatar, the conversation's name (the agent's name for a one-to-one, not @human+linen), the time with seconds, numbered answers, and a reply field showing the chord that sends. Banners past the first fold into one line naming who they are from.

Colors: the banner sits over the panes, so it takes the terminal's background and foreground (decision chrome-colors, and the color card).
title: Restyle the message banner as on the Lectern page
